cand.title: GDPM 2027: 10th International Workshop on Grapevine Downy and Powdery Mildews

verifyPrev.futureEditionText: Confirmed upcoming: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Switzerland. These are workshop activity dates, not the 5 October 2026 announcement date. Both the French Agroscope announcement and the official event website agree; dates fall within the requested horizon.
verifyPrev.venueText: Workshop announced at Agroscope Changins – Aula. Pre-reserved hotel rooms are advertised with booking deadline 31 March 2027; hotel identities and contractual status unresolved.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: VERIFICATION GAP UNRESOLVED: no named person with an explicit organizer, meetings, housing or commercial role for GDPM 2027 was verified. The official edition contact is the shared mailbox info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch; it is not a named buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Switzerland. The Agroscope announcement was published on 5 October 2026; that is not an event date.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced venue: Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Switzerland, in La Côte. This is an announced meeting venue, not evidence of a hotel contract.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The official edition website advertises pre-reserved hotel rooms with a booking deadline of 31 March 2027. Hotel names, block sizes, contractual terms and acceptance of additional hotels remain unverified. Hotel sourcing must not be classified as open.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is explicitly identified as organizer of the 2027 edition. No individual accommodation decision-maker or appointed PCO was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Pre-reserved rooms already exist; this does not establish exclusivity, sell-out, overflow demand or remaining demand accessible to YOTEL.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch requesting the name and role of the person coordinating accommodation for GDPM 2027, an introduction to that person, and confirmation whether additional accommodation partners can be considered. Ask which hotels are pre-reserved and whether participants book independently. Do not present YOTEL as an approved or overflow hotel.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, only the general enquiries route is verified. Neither an open hotel procurement process nor authority to add accommodation partners is established.
